design.status: FORM002 preserved form rebuilt for gesture and fabrication checks; no manufacturing approval
design.provenance: Anatomy-derived finger links, user-directed palm extension 127 to 150 mm and thumb links shortened to 65/50 mm. Mesh transforms are frozen here; pin holes and shells require CAD rebuilding.
design.coordinates: Design/STL in millimetres, preview.xml body positions in metres. +Y toward fingertips, +Z palm-facing, +X index side. STL coordinates are joint-local, not assembled world coordinates.
design.acceptance_scope: Form approximately accepted; webcam jitter/transitions rejected. No collision, strength, actuation or manufacturability acceptance.
design.fist_path_scope: 33 authored visual poses; not measured tracking or collision evidence

gesture_candidate_pose_catalog.reference_fields_notice: Top-level fist_deg/fist_path remain the original accepted FORM002 reference. Current target gestures and candidate paths are defined separately in poses.json.

interpretation.pin_rotation: Passive floating pin with a head screwdriver slot; pin rotation and friction are not solved.
interpretation.body_assignment: Pin, keeper washer and retaining screw use the original pin parent body as a neutral placement and centreline-motion reference, not a dynamic spin constraint.
interpretation.fastener_reference: Nominal DIN 9021 M2 washer and DIN 912 M2x4 socket-head screw envelopes; source_docs must be present and hash-bound before construction.
interpretation.density: All three new/modified metal parts use the v1 steel assumption 7.85e-6 kg/mm3, not measured A2 hardware density or weight.
interpretation.axial_retention: Screw clamps the keeper washer against the pin end. Locking method, preload, thread strip strength, tool access and actual endplay require separate validation.
interpretation.outer_envelopes: Zero-travel pin envelope fills only the screwdriver slot, retaining its female-hole void. Travelled pin envelope fills voids conservatively. Screw envelope fills its socket. These are nominal geometric clearance envelopes, not thread-insertion simulation.
interpretation.unchanged_design: The manufacturing_v1 joint frames, lengths, exterior and exploratory thumb IP range are retained; no new physical travel approval.

requests.range_note: Engineering exploration, not a universal anatomical envelope. Ordinary extension checks precede extra margins. Isolated spread/CMC extrema with stationary neighbours are stress probes, not proof of a required human pose. Full Cartesian products are not assumed anatomically feasible.

sources.evidence: 390 hands; observed active extension at MCP, PIP and DIP; variation between subjects and digits.
sources.use: Motivates extension tests; engineering bounds are our choices, not population coverage claims.

partition.kinematics: Drive build references the identical manufacturing_v2 design hash; same neutral-world STEP frames and explicit body labels. No joint-frame edits.

scope: 364 hand parts only. Separate external motor bench, tendon routing and later isolated testbench are not installed whole-hand hardware. Finite rigid nominal poses; no physical or continuous-motion release.
